lines.trans: Sigourney, what is going on?
I am going back to Los Angeles.

words.gloss: to go home, to come back

lines.trans: But why?
I must take this plane.
You have twelve hours to explain.
I thought that Gaspard Ulliel would be my partner.
But nobody said that.
An American woman who leaves everything for love...
For a young professor, I thought that was compelling.
Gaspard Ulliel is thirty-five years old.
It is time for things to change.
And Gaspard will be my lover.
